source.scope: Static exact source-equation analysis; no importing source package, constructor, reset/do, RNG or private runtime data. This is not new original scientific first-use or confirmatory blind source science.

experiments.question: Does the fixed original source equation make previous reward conditionally informative once current public state/action are known?
experiments.method: Verify exact source blob; parse restricted AST of original reward and state-transition expressions; independently enumerate all eight nominal Bernoulli latent combinations with rational probabilities from source lambdas. Calculate full reward/next-state joint kernel for all four state/action pairs. Verify source reward expression depends only on current state/action and fresh u1,u3; transition only current state/action and fresh u1,u2; sample_u requests fresh draws each do. Under that stated iid stochastic source model, additional public past rewards cannot change population conditional outcome probabilities.
experiments.known_before_run: Analyst has inspected original source equations and .1/.9 parameters, so this is an EXPLORATORY_SOURCE_MECHANISM_DERIVATION, not a newly learned relationship or blind statistical discovery.
experiments.controls: Independent direct integer Boolean equations must exactly match restricted-AST evaluation on all32 state/action/latent combinations; probabilities sum to1. No learned model receives source oracle probabilities.

experiments.question: Did the UNCHANGED NKR19 statistical knowledge infer action choices that have theoretical value under the original source model?
experiments.native: Reconstruct original NKR19 counts from exact previously consumed public prefixes8,16,24 events/world using unchanged native observe/update mapping. Require exact same pre-interference checkpoint hashes as sealed NKR19 result.json. Choose larger Beta(1,1) reward probability, action0 on exact tie. Derive action maps BEFORE oracle scoring; no oracle-fed training or new native parameters.
controls: independent conventional Beta fit from identical public prefixes must match all native choices
source-oracle a=state is an evaluator-only upper bound, never an equal-information learned control
experiments.scoring: Exact nominal source-kernel distribution propagation, seven steps for every scale. Report a COMMON uniform initial-state distribution to isolate learned-policy differences, and separately each already observed public state after prefix k. k+7<=31. This is source-model-conditioned expected reward, NOT newly executed source actions, sampled simulation or empirically measured policy performance. Earlier data-only counterfactual bounds remain valid without these extra source-equation assumptions.
experiments.frozen_development_rule: At scale24, >=6 of8 world/state native choices are source-oracle optimal AND common-start mean expected reward/step exceeds mechanical by>=0.10; else THEORETICAL_DECISION_VALUE_NOT_ESTABLISHED. Always report scale curves, state-conditioned values, equal-information control tie and oracle ceiling. SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false.
experiments.limits: Known tiny two-state source model; no unfamiliar physics, generalized discovery, source-authentic new policy rollouts, neural superiority or gain over strongest same-information exact control.
